sessions.one_line: Designed and built the ladder_overlay study end to end; the day-long scrape finished but review/write-up were still pending.
Built a private Drive mirror for journal output (folder layout, monthly grouping, _history/ CSVs) and committed it.
Added ladder_overlay doc/catalog entries across catalog.py, arm-index, glossary, study-map, next-steps as assigned.
Built ladder_targets lib + fetch_ladder_legs collector; 130 tests pass, flake8 clean after fixing E127/E128 loops.
Built ladder_overlay study module + tests; study ran 3x to DESIGNED REFUSAL, 94 tests pass, flake8 clean.
Explored financed_spread study code/docs to answer questions on arms, gates, and pricing tiers.
Wrote the ladder_overlay pre-registration (547 lines), verified doc-links, touched no other file.
Added per-ticker breach-overage summary to trade journal report/page; committed in three separate commits.
Diagnosed and fixed enrich_oi's stale 1-session watchdog lag hiding the newest day; committed the fix.
Researched study registration conventions and the research log for a new backtest_study.
Explored how financed/overlay multi-leg positions and ladder decomposition are modeled in code.
Built overlay_campaign.py pricing engine and 42 new tests, all passing, uncommitted.
Designed the ladder_overlay study implementation plan (f3_structure), read-only.
Mapped option-history cache, frozen harness and pricing helpers for the new study's data needs.
Ran daily-journal-review and appended analysis to the 2026-09-09 Notion journal entry.
Explained tier, exit and journal-matching consequences of subbing a bull put spread for a bull call spread play.
Confirmed --net-liq overrides .env's JOURNAL_NET_LIQUIDATION; left a doc/docstring/test fix uncommitted.
Root-caused mech_cell NO_DATA to a late-published Yahoo Finance SPY bar; explained the nightly self-heal.
Empty digest: no prompt, no tool calls, no final text captured.
Baseline + Attempts 1-7 tuning exit rules; the reactive-exit and trailing-stop-dead-code lessons first stated.
Pooled evals at 523/607 rows, 13c validation, cpir composition kill, the deployment ladder derived.
Gate eval at 762 rows, score_total removed from the ladder, versioning rule from the 13c join trap, regime-label validation.
25-date gate close-out, mech_regime exits shipped, Barchart silent-fallback trap, mech_cell shipped.
Completed-book close-out: ML null result, be_after shipped, the DEBIT_PROD baseline lesson, v3 cut-over mechanics.
Edge status, bear MFE give-back quantified, be_after grid re-run against shipped production, day-0 conditioning.
First v3 runs of five studies, plus two gate lessons (account_sim date floor, calendar_hedge snapshot gate).
Living research record behind docs/deployment-rules.md; carries the DEBIT_PROD and 60-row-floor lessons.

findings.summary: Any input change is a new analysis version writing to new vN_ tabs in place; never append changed-input rows to an existing tab or pool across versions.

findings.summary: Same flake8 E127/E128 continuation-indent errors recur when subagents write multi-line code via string-patch/heredoc edits, costing repeated flake8-fix-rerun cycles.
findings.proposed_action: Note in CLAUDE.md that new multi-line calls should use hanging indent (one arg per line, 4-space indent, no visual alignment) or be run through a formatter before flake8, to avoid the E127/E128 fix loop.

findings.summary: A minimum-dates floor is not a density floor: a backfilled era can clear the date-count gate while having zero dates that are actually consecutive.
findings.proposed_action: archive/16 §"2026-08-19 — `account_sim` on v4: the date floor is not a density floor"; archive/16 §"2026-08-19 — `portfolio_delta` first run (era v3): NOISE on the primary — and the census is the real finding: the deployed ladder is LONG-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION"; add to research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A rollback-trigger census that only just clears its row/date floor on a still-backfilling book is not a stable decision; it can flip on the next backfill export.
findings.proposed_action: deployment-evidence.md §"The bear-debit peak-triggered breakeven stop (shipped 2026-08-11 — REVERTED 2026-08-24)"; deployment-evidence.md §"Open pre-registered rollback triggers"; add to research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A validation gate that compares live output to a hand-transcribed snapshot constant breaks silently as its underlying cache grows; compare two live-run outputs instead.
findings.proposed_action: archive/16 §"2026-08-19 — `calendar_hedge` R4: a gate keyed to a snapshot is not a gate"; add to research/lessons.md

findings.summary: config/pipeline-health.yml's enrich_oi lag_sessions=1 encoded a stale D+1 rationale, so the watchdog marked the newest session 'not due' instead of checking it.
findings.proposed_action: When setting a stage's lag_sessions, comment why against actual run order (not just the data's D+1 semantics), and audit other stages for the same stale assumption.

findings.summary: Agent re-armed long-lived background watchers for the scrape four times; the OS low-memory guard killed each before it gave up and switched to manual polling.
findings.proposed_action: Note in the research-tier sharp edges that multi-hour scrapes should be checked by manual polling, not a long-lived background watcher, since the low-memory guard kills those in this environment.

findings.summary: scripts/analyze_bt_queue.sh sits untracked in the repo; two unrelated sessions on the same day both noticed it and left it alone.
findings.proposed_action: Decide whether scripts/analyze_bt_queue.sh is a real tool or dead code, then either commit and document it or delete it.

findings.summary: Explore subagent re-read lib/barchart/session.py 4x and config/backtest.yml 3x instead of reading each once.
findings.proposed_action: When a file is already in context, grep the needed section instead of re-issuing a full Read of the same file.

findings.summary: Journal session edited prose/code via ad hoc python heredoc replace scripts, hitting AssertionError/lint failures three times and needing 9/5/4/4 near-identical retries per file.
findings.proposed_action: Prefer the Edit tool for doc and code edits over one-off python heredoc string replacements, which fail silently on a changed anchor and cost a retry cycle.

findings.summary: Read tool called on a bare directory path (EISDIR) in two separate Explore subagents instead of listing it first.
findings.proposed_action: Tell Explore-type subagents to list a directory with ls/find before Read, never Read a bare directory path.

findings.summary: The ladder_overlay plan was written on an estimated contract count; the collector's dry run then found far more targets than estimated, making the scrape the session's long pole.
findings.proposed_action: Run the relevant collector's dry-run for real target counts before committing a new study's pre-registration and plan, not after.

findings.summary: trailing_stop_trigger is dead code whenever profit_target is set below its trigger level, because profit_target always fires first.
findings.proposed_action: archive/01 §"Attempt 3 — BETTER, exit config now stable ✓"; archive/01 §"Attempt 5 — IDENTICAL ❌ (trailing_stop_trigger=2.00, hard exit)"; add to research/lessons.md

findings.summary: A doc-order fix, docstring and test clarifying --net-liq's precedence over .env were written but never committed.
findings.proposed_action: Commit the pending doc-order fix, docstring and test for --net-liq precedence from session fd1d8b02.

findings.summary: scripts/analyze_bt_queue.sh, self-labeled THROWAWAY and 'deliberately uncommitted', was committed to git history instead of being folded or deleted per its own header.
findings.proposed_action: Fold analyze_bt_queue.sh into scrape_and_enrich.sh or delete it, now that its throwaway status has been overridden by a commit.

findings.summary: Agent asked the user to place three CSVs using the abstract word "state"; the user rejected the question and needed a follow-up round to get a plain-language answer.
findings.proposed_action: When asking the user where a file belongs, name the concrete file (e.g. "the three run-history CSVs") instead of an abstract noun like "state".

findings.summary: Explore subagent re-read financed_spread.py and the archive/16 volume 3 times each in one session, producing no new information.
findings.proposed_action: none

findings.summary: The general-purpose builder agent ran the same python3 heredoc patch script 3x instead of using the Edit tool.
findings.proposed_action: Prefer the Edit tool over repeated python3 heredoc rewrites when patching a file already on disk.

findings.summary: rtk's find wrapper refuses compound predicates (-o, -type combos) with an error instead of running; plain find is required for those.
findings.proposed_action: Use plain find (not the rtk wrapper) whenever a search needs -o/-not/-exec or other compound predicates.

findings.summary: Globbing backtests/option_history_cache/*.csv (43k+ files, per abbd94cf88cb39f75) overflowed the shell arg list; no rule warns to use find instead.
findings.proposed_action: Add a note near option_history_cache in CLAUDE.md that its tens of thousands of files overflow a shell glob and must be listed with find, not ls/echo *.csv.

findings.summary: A new episodic memory note (project_ladder_overlay_study.md) tracks the still-open ladder_overlay study; its lesson content belongs in research/lessons.md once the review and write-up land.
findings.proposed_action: After the ladder_overlay two-analyst review and research/current.md write-up land, fold the episodic memory note's findings into research/lessons.md and retire the note.

findings.summary: Digest 047f8a6e (2026-09-15) has 8 records, no prompt, no tool calls and no final text — an empty session occupying a batch slot.
findings.proposed_action: Investigate why 047f8a6e produced no content and exclude empty sessions like it from future dream batches.

findings.summary: rtk find rejected a compound predicate (-o) with an error; the agent had to retry with plain find, costing a call.
findings.proposed_action: Note in CLAUDE.md's RTK section that rtk find refuses compound predicates (-o/-not/-exec) and to use plain find for those.
